lines.text: Amos warns those who long for the Day of the LORD that it will be darkness and not light.
Amos says it is like a man who flees from a lion, only to encounter a wolf.
The LORD says He hates their feasts, will not accept their offerings, and will not listen to their harps.
The LORD wants justice to roll on like a river, and asks about offerings in the wilderness for forty years.
The LORD says He will send Israel into exile beyond Babylon because they took along idols they made.
